image_query: Dancing Girl of Mohenjo-daro bronze statue National Museum New Delhi
tweets: The Dancing Girl of Mohenjo-daro — barely 10.5 cm tall, cast in bronze via the lost-wax method c. 2500 BCE. One arm ringed in bangles, hip cocked, chin lifted: the Indus Valley’s earliest known image of pure self-possession.
